author_notes: Slot slot_192 targets interactive_canvas / design_continuity / restyle / section / L4, capability Edit. MisterPrada/logo-particles-template is a runnable Vite + three.js particle-logo canvas whose strong local WebGL system (a fullscreen PRADA-emblem particle field with depth-of-field, a GSAP motion trail, and a Tweakpane debug rail) is exposed only through a generic 3d-app-template shell. The restyle adds the fictional Halcyon Signal identity stage by the fictional studio Fieldkit as an on-canvas Signal Deck HUD: a masthead, a four-tile status strip (Emblem in motion / Depth & focus / Motion memory / Tunable rail), a signal-channel selector (All layers / Emblem / Depth / Trail) with a live readout of what the particle field is resolving, editing only src/index.html and src/style.css and leaving the three.js scene, GLSL, GSAP and Tweakpane rail untouched. The deck must read as one persistent instrument across every channel context, stay legible over the scene, and not overflow a 390px phone. Local assets: /textures/prada-logo.png, /textures/displacement.jpg, /textures/particles/1.png, /models/fox.glb. Difficulty raised L3->L4 in-place: the deck's status strip carries a responsive-overflow lever, the deck layout carries a visual-fidelity lever, the deck's cross-context presence carries a design-continuity lever, and the channel selector's readout carries an interaction lever.
design_constraints: Keep the visual language anchored in the existing dark cinematic background, monochrome particle field, blurred depth-of-field points, and compact technical controls of the WebGL stage.
The Signal Deck must be a restrained on-canvas HUD (masthead + status strip + channel selector + readout), not a large hero page, card-heavy marketing section, modal, or separate route.
Use responsive constraints so the deck's status strip remains readable at desktop, tablet, and 390px mobile without horizontal overflow.

Keep the deck visually lighter than the canvas: it should identify the Halcyon Signal brand and current signal channel without blocking the particle logo field, and its status tiles must stay legible (no dark-on-dark) rather than overgrowing into slabs that overlap and bury the scene.

The signal-channel selector must be a real control: picking a channel updates a live readout naming that channel and its live-layer count, and the deck must be present in every channel context, not only the default 'all' view.
The debug panel may be repositioned, scaled, softened, or hidden on mobile, but the desktop Tweakpane Start interaction must remain available and the scene untouched.

change_completion: The page exposes a visible data-stage-chrome='particle-logo' Signal Deck carrying the Halcyon Signal brand persona.

The deck presents the studio kicker (Fieldkit), the heading 'Signal deck', an intro summary, four labelled status tiles (Emblem in motion / Depth & focus / Motion memory / Tunable rail), a signal-channel selector, and a live readout.
The signal-channel selector updates the readout to name the picked channel (e.g. 'Now reading: Emblem field') rather than a frozen default line.
The page title and copy identify the Halcyon Signal particle stage by Fieldkit rather than the generic 3d-app-template.
design_consistency: The deck extends the existing dark, cinematic particle aesthetic through typography, spacing, glass/rail treatment, and compact technical language.
The fullscreen WebGL particle field remains the primary visual artifact, with the deck acting as an on-canvas status/control instrument rather than replacing the scene.
The Signal Deck is present and coherent in every channel context, reading as one persistent instrument across the stage.
regression: The WebGL canvas, preloader canvas, module script entry, and Tweakpane debug rail (Debug / Renderer / PostProcess / Particles / Progress / Animation / Start) all remain present and functional.
Clicking the Tweakpane Start button in the debug rail still works after the restyle.
responsive: The Signal Deck renders without horizontal overflow at desktop (1440), tablet (834), and mobile (390) widths.
On mobile the deck's status strip wraps instead of forcing the document wider than the viewport, and the tiles stay legible.

problem_statement: The logo-particles-template project renders a fullscreen three.js particle logo field, but the browser presents it as a raw 3d-app-template: the tab title is generic and the only foreground UI is the raw Tweakpane debug rail. Restyle the foreground into a polished, coherent on-canvas Signal Deck for the fictional 'Halcyon Signal' live particle identity stage presented by the fictional studio Fieldkit, while PRESERVING the WebGL particle scene, preloader canvas, and the Tweakpane debug rail (Debug / Renderer / PostProcess / Particles / Progress / Animation / Start) untouched. Edit only the foreground files (src/index.html and src/style.css): add a masthead (kicker Fieldkit, heading 'Signal deck', intro), a four-tile status strip (Emblem in motion / Depth & focus / Motion memory / Tunable rail), and a signal-channel selector (All layers / Emblem / Depth / Trail) whose live readout names what the particle field is currently resolving. The deck must be present in every channel context, stay legible over the scene, and not overflow a 390px phone. Do not touch the three.js scene, GLSL, or GSAP; do not replace the WebGL renderer with an image or video; do not remove the Tweakpane Start control; do not convert the app into a separate landing page. This is an on-canvas stage-chrome restyle with a working signal-channel control, not a marketing rewrite.
required_content: Rebrand the page title away from the generic 3d-app-template to a specific Halcyon Signal particle identity stage title.
Add a visible on-canvas Signal Deck section carrying the exact data attribute data-stage-chrome='particle-logo'.

The deck must present the Halcyon Signal persona: the studio kicker (Fieldkit), the heading 'Signal deck', an intro summary, four labelled status tiles (Emblem in motion / Depth & focus / Motion memory / Tunable rail), and a signal-channel selector with a live readout.

The signal-channel selector must be a working control: clicking a channel (e.g. Emblem) updates the live readout to name that channel and its live-layer count, not a frozen default line. The readout uses the exact line format "Now reading: <Channel> field · <n> layer(s) live" (the default 'all' view reads "Now reading: All layers · 3 layers live", and picking Emblem makes it read "Now reading: Emblem field · 1 layer live").
The Signal Deck must be present in every channel context (all / emblem / depth / trail), reading as one persistent instrument, not only the default 'all' view.

Preserve the fullscreen WebGL canvas, the preloader canvas, the module script entry, the debug-panel mount, and the Tweakpane rail labels Debug, Renderer, PostProcess, Particles, Progress, Animation, and Start.

Keep the deck subordinate to the canvas on desktop, legible (no dark-on-dark, no overgrown overlapping tiles), and readable on 390px mobile without horizontal overflow, and keep the desktop Start interaction usable.

Do not add dependencies, replace the WebGL renderer with an image or video, remove the Tweakpane Start interaction, hide the brand copy off-screen, fetch remote media, keep the generic 3d-app-template title, or convert the app into a separate landing page.
state_constraints: desktop_initial checks the fullscreen particle canvas, the Halcyon Signal Signal Deck, the four status tiles, and the preserved Tweakpane debug rail.
tablet_initial verifies the deck and canvas remain balanced on tablet width without horizontal overflow.
mobile_initial verifies the deck's status strip wraps and is readable on 390px mobile without forcing horizontal overflow.
desktop_deck frames the Signal Deck for the visual-fidelity check (legible tiles, no overgrown overlapping slabs) and is the pre-click state for the channel readout.
mobile_deck re-checks the mobile deck after a longer render interval so the overlay does not depend on a transient loader state.
desktop_channel_pick clicks the Emblem signal channel and verifies the readout updates to name that channel.
desktop_ch_emblem / desktop_ch_depth / desktop_ch_trail verify the deck is present in every channel context.
desktop_start clicks the existing Tweakpane Start button to confirm the debug rail remains functional after the restyle.
